tldr: Lilith in the 2nd house: the untamed shows in worth, money, and the body
body: Lilith in the 2nd house: the untamed shows in worth, money, and the body. Where you reclaim pleasure and value on your own terms. Watch: using worth or sensuality as leverage. You refuse to be controlled through money or made to feel undeserving; raw drive around resources and worth. A conflicted relationship with money: rejecting it as a symbol of control while secretly wanting it intensely, plus a fear of loss. Can unconsciously create scarcity until the conflict is faced.
business: Reclaims financial autonomy and the right to your own value.
shadow: Money as a battleground, or shame and self-denial around having.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
